fields.subject_definitions: <Subject 1> is Lin Che from <Picture 1>. <Subject 2> is He Yuan from <Picture 2>. <Audio 1> is the selected music source.
fields.summary: New shot referencing: A key handoff at a counter.
fields.retention_analysis: <Subject 1>: retain identity. <Subject 2>: retain identity. <Audio 1>: fully_copy; add the new response and a metal contact sound.
fields.detailed_description: Natural interior light. [Shot 1] Lin Che uses his right hand to place the brass key at the right side of the counter. The key remains on the counter as the hand withdraws. At 00:05.000, [Shot 2] He Yuan looks at the key and says (S1) in Chinese, <d>我知道了。</d>.
fields.overall_soundscape: One metal contact sound and He Yuan’s reply accompany the copied music.
fields.non_diegetic_music: The selected source music continues throughout.
